guidanceConsulted.query: warning banner alert semantics accessible navigation
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use semantic landmarks, role='note' with descriptive aria-label for non-interruptive informational/experimental warnings (avoiding live-region role='alert' noise on static page load), sequential headings, focusable scroll regions, and titled iframes.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: .warn-block uses role='note' aria-label='Experimental feature notice', <nav class='local-nav' aria-label='On this page'> provides keyboard jump links, tables use captions + <th scope> + aria-labelledby on .table-wrap, and the embedded iframe includes a descriptive title attribute.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive data table mobile overflow typography
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use logical max-inline-size: 100% on media/iframes and scrollable containers, avoid overflow: hidden clipping, and let flex-wrap handle variable-width badge lists.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: .example-embed iframe and .table-wrap use max-inline-size: 100%, relying on shared public/styles.css for .baseline-browsers wrapping and pre scrolling.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive data table mobile overflow typography
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Preserve balanced heading wrapping and clean code/prose contrast via shared design tokens rather than per-page inline overrides.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: omitted inline overrides on h1, pre, code, and blockquote so shared public/styles.css typography and light-dark() tokens apply consistently.
